category_title: Middle school student with autism and language impairment exhibiting property destruction and self-injury when frustrated
minimal_context: Carrie is working one-on-one with a peer to read an article about the culture of Japan in a general education setting.
dialogue:
TUTOR: We are reading this article about the culture of Japan. Did you finish reading the first page?

STUDENT: Yes.

TUTOR: Okay. What did you learn about the culture of Japan from this page?

STUDENT: (mumbles unintelligibly)

TUTOR: I didn't catch that. How would you describe their traditions?

STUDENT: (moves physically closer and continues to make unintelligible sounds)

options.A: Use opportunities to respond (OTRs) to maintain the student's orientation and engagement with the article.
options.B: Advise the student to take a short 5-15 minute break before returning to the article.
options.C: Explicitly incorporate elements into the reading activity that promote the student's self-compassion.
options.D: Use age-appropriate and grade-level materials, such as the article about the culture of Japan.
